consent.title: Authorization Request
consent.description: {app} is requesting access to your account

codes.access_denied: This happens when the sign-in page was left open too long, or when the request did not come from it.
codes.unauthorized_client: This application is not allowed to sign in.
codes.unsupported_response_type: This sign-in method is not supported.
codes.invalid_scope: The application asked for access it does not have.
codes.server_error: A server-side error occurred. If retrying does not help, contact support and quote the code.
codes.temporarily_unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
codes.invalid_token: Sign-in was not confirmed: the token is invalid or expired. Please start signing in again.
codes.unsupported_prompt_type: An unknown sign-in mode was requested.
codes.consent_required: Consent is required, but no consent screen is configured.
codes.login_required: Sign-in is required, but no screen may be shown: the application asked to do without one.
